step_by_step_approach: Collect all on‑track position changes that occur during race laps.
Remove any position changes that are linked to pit entry, pit exit, driver retirements, or the first lap of a race.
For each driver, count how many times they were overtaken in the remaining records.
For each driver, count how many times they overtook another driver in the remaining records.
Select the drivers whose count of being overtaken exceeds their count of overtaking.
Return the full names of those selected drivers.
